TechnoCore Engineering (Pvt) Ltd brings a combined track record in grid-relevant solar deployments and delivery inside public-sector healthcare environments—an advantage for executing twelve live hospital sites with minimal disruption and clear accountability. We are an SECP-incorporated company established in 2012, with active FBR ATL status and Punjab/Sindh sales tax registrations, positioning us for compliant contracting with Government of Punjab entities [CO-PROFILE].

For your 5 MW aggregate requirement, we offer evidence-backed solar implementation capacity through multiple completed solar energy projects, including PKR 171M (completed 2024), PKR 42M (completed 2022), PKR 34M (completed 2020), and PKR 31M for a Provincial Government client (completed 2024) [CAP-032][CAP-044][CAP-020][CAP-008]. In parallel, our experience delivering hospital IT projects for Federal and Provincial Government clients strengthens our approach to stakeholder coordination, access control, and on-site safety protocols typical of hospital operations [CAP-042][CAP-018].

Key differentiators aligned to the RFP include:
- Quality-led delivery under an ISO 9001 quality management system [CO-PROFILE].
- Structured governance with PMP-certified project managers (6 on staff) and PE-registered engineers (4), supporting controlled execution across multiple concurrent sites [CO-PROFILE].
- Maintainability by design: an in-country support desk with 24–48 hour response SLAs and quarterly preventive maintenance offered on O&M contracts, aligned to your three-year O&M expectations [CO-PROFILE].

Where the RFP is explicit, we are equally transparent: our library does not yet evidence a SCADA-based central dashboard across multiple sites, nor the specific Tier-1 module efficiency (≥21%) and 25-year linear warranty requirement; we will address these via named OEM/SCADA partnering and submit full datasheets, warranties, and architecture in the Technical Proposal to close these mandatory gaps.

Financial and bid assurance: we maintain a bank guarantee facility of PKR 100M and can arrange bid securities from scheduled banks up to that facility limit [CO-PROFILE].
